content.title: Subgroup Dialogue Coverage | Pair-to-Pair Relay, Whole-Table Recombine
content.summary: Establish a shared social space with the first seated pair and make visible speaking-turn ownership readable inside that pair. Cut across the table for a distinct response phase, then return wider to recombine every participant with the same table anchors. Source dialogue meaning remains unknown.

quick_start.input_format: Stable group space + visible speaking turn of the first group + relay of the second group + 1 non-verbal action + everyone ends in the same frame
quick_start.recommended_input: The four original restaurant staff first establish a spatial relationship as a two-person group, then cut to another two-person group to complete speeches and non-verbal actions, and finally return to the four people in the same frame; the meaning of the dialogue in the original film is not specified.
required_anchors: Establish the first subgroup and shared table anchors before any cross-table cut.
Make speaking-turn ownership visibly readable within the first subgroup without assigning source meaning.
Give the second subgroup one distinct response phase and one listening witness.
Recombine all participants with the same spatial anchors in a held wide view.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a shared social space with the first seated pair and make visible speaking-turn ownership readable inside that pair. Cut across the table for a distinct response phase, then return wider to recombine every participant with the same table anchors. Source dialogue meaning remains unknown.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one shared social geography by showing the first seated pair, hand visual speaking-turn ownership within that pair, cut across the table to a second pair for a distinct response phase, then return to a wider composition that recombines all participants and the same table anchors. Source dialogue meaning is unknown; only visible turn ownership and coverage order are reusable.

invariants.rule: Establish the first subgroup and shared table anchors before any cross-table cut.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on singles hides group geography.

invariants.rule: Make speaking-turn ownership visibly readable within the first subgroup without assigning source meaning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Indistinct mouth and eye ownership makes the cut arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Cut to a second subgroup that faces back into the same shared space.
invariants.purpose: Expands the conversation while preserving geography.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new unrelated location breaks the group.

invariants.rule: Give the second subgroup one distinct response phase and one listening witness.
invariants.ablation_failure: Both people performing at once hides ownership.

invariants.rule: Recombine all participants with the same spatial anchors in a held wide view.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a pair leaves the larger group unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source beach bar and four actors
the exact male-pair to female-pair coverage
